_comment: Editor UI metadata for MPC Extreme Leg. Overlaid onto the schema built from ExtremeLegConfig. UI ONLY — it never touches a trade decision or the source hash. Click Scan Strategies after editing. LABELS are the Pine input titles VERBATIM (one parameter, one name, two UIs — changed in the same commit as the Pine). DESCRIPTIONS are NOT verbatim, and that is deliberate: docs/STRATEGY_WORKFLOW.md still says the desc should be the tooltip word for word, but the later copy rule (Aaron, 2026-08-10) says every desc is SHORT and PLAIN — what the setting does, what each choice means, and the one fact that changes the decision. No measurement dumps, no trade counts, no R figures, no dates, no file references. This strategy's Pine tooltips carry measurements, so the two rules genuinely conflict here and the newer, explicit one wins. The evidence behind each default lives in this package's CLAUDE.md. The platform fields on the config (point value, symbol, the structure constants) have no Pine input behind them and are deliberately absent below.
edge: This is the move that happens BEFORE the setup the main bot trades. Price runs to an extreme, grabs the liquidity sitting above or below a level, and then turns — and the turn is what breaks structure. The main bot waits for that break and then trades the pullback. This one takes the run into it. Stop goes beyond the extreme that just held, and the exit rests part of the way to the swing being aimed at, because the point is to take money off and free the slot rather than to hold for the whole move.

steps.label: 01 · Grab
steps.title: A level gets taken
steps.detail: Price runs through a high or low that other traders were using — yesterday's, the session's, the last four hours', or last week's. Nothing arms without that.

steps.label: 02 · Turn
steps.title: The turn confirms
steps.detail: Within a few hours of the grab, the short-term structure shifts the other way. That shift is the trigger, and it has to go against the fifteen-minute trend to count.

steps.label: 03 · Price it
steps.title: The stop and the target
steps.detail: The stop sits beyond the extreme that just held, plus a little room. The target is the fifteen-minute swing overhead. If that swing is too close to be worth the risk, the setup is refused.

steps.label: 04 · Bank it
steps.title: Take money off and free the slot
steps.detail: The exit rests part of the way to the swing rather than at it. Only one position is held at a time, so getting out sooner is what makes the next setup possible.

params.name: exec_risk_pct
params.label: ↳ Risk % per trade
params.desc: How much of the account each trade risks. The stop distance sets the position size, so a tighter stop buys a bigger position at the same risk.

params.name: size_mode
params.label: Position sizing
params.desc: Risk % of equity makes every trade the same size in risk terms, so results compound. Fixed contracts uses the same quantity whatever the stop is.

params.name: fixed_qty
params.label: ↳ Contracts
params.desc: The quantity used when sizing is set to fixed contracts. Ignored otherwise.

params.name: exec_longs
params.label: Trade longs
params.desc: Lets long setups trade. Off = shorts only.

params.name: exec_shorts
params.label: Trade shorts
params.desc: Lets short setups trade. Off = longs only.

params.name: swept_minutes
params.label: A level must have been swept within (minutes)
params.desc: How recently the liquidity grab must have happened for a turn to count as this setup. Nothing arms without a grab.
guide: Only a turn right after the grab counts
Allows a slower turn, and takes more setups

params.name: req_counter_trend
params.label: Only against the 15-minute trend
params.desc: On = the swing being aimed at has to be a turn rather than a continuation. Off roughly doubles the number of setups and halves how good they are.

params.name: use_h4_level
params.label: Arm on a 4-hour level
params.desc: The last completed four-hour candle's high and low. The most common level, and the weakest of the ones that work.

params.name: use_session_level
params.label: Arm on a session level
params.desc: The last finished Asia, London or New York session's high and low. One of the two strongest.

params.name: use_daily_level
params.label: Arm on the previous day's level
params.desc: Yesterday's high and low. The strongest single kind of level here.

params.name: use_weekly_level
params.label: Arm on the previous week's level
params.desc: Last week's high and low. Too rare on its own for anything to be said about it either way.

params.name: min_families
params.label: Levels that must agree
params.desc: How many different kinds of level must be grabbed together on the same bar. Two is better than one and roughly halves the number of setups.
guide: Needs several kinds at once — far fewer, better setups

params.name: skip_friday
params.label: Never open a trade on a Friday
params.desc: Fridays were free: they made nothing over the whole history while accounting for a quarter of the losses. Skipping them left the money alone and made the worst losing run shorter. Read in UTC, which is how it was measured.

params.name: extreme_minutes
params.label: Look back for the extreme (minutes)
params.desc: How far back to look for the high or low the stop goes beyond. That extreme is the thing the trade is betting has held.
guide: Tight stop, close to the turn
Wider stop, further back — smaller position

params.name: stop_buffer_atr
params.label: Stop buffer (ATR)
params.desc: Extra room beyond the extreme, as a fraction of the average range. Zero puts the stop exactly on the extreme.
guide: Stop sits right on the extreme
Plenty of room beyond it — wider stop, smaller position

params.name: tp_frac
params.label: Take profit at this much of the way to the swing
params.desc: One aims at the swing itself. A half books half the distance and wins far more often — and because only one position is held at a time, getting out sooner frees the slot for the next setup.
guide: Books a small piece and gets out fast
Holds for the whole swing — wins less often

params.name: use_breakeven
params.label: Move the stop to breakeven
params.desc: Off by default. Moving it early turns winners into scratches, and moving it late is worth almost nothing.

params.name: be_arm_frac
params.label: ↳ Arm at this much of the way to the target
params.desc: How far price has to travel before the stop moves up. Below about two thirds of the way this costs money.

params.name: min_r
params.label: Refuse a target nearer than (R)
params.desc: Refuses a setup whose swing is closer than this many stop distances. Without it most setups have no room to pay.
guide: Only setups with a long way to run

params.name: min_stop_usd
params.label: Minimum stop distance ($)
params.desc: Refuses a stop tighter than this. A tight stop does not make the risk small, it makes the position large. Zero switches it off.
